text: Submitted my PhD thesis, titled Bringing People into Integrated Assessment Models: Constructing Endogenous Representations of Human Behaviour, to the Department of Geography, University of Bergen.
Awarded the Dana Meadows Award Honorable Mention for the second time at the 2026 International System Dynamics Conference.
My System Dynamics Review paper on feedback stories ranked within the top 10% of most-viewed papers published in 2024.
My System Dynamics Review paper on feedback stories was named among the top 10 most-cited papers published in 2024.
Published a structured curriculum combining feedback-story analysis with Loops That Matter in System Dynamics Review.
Received the Dana Meadows Award Honorable Mention (USD 500) at the 2025 International System Dynamics Conference.
